questions.question: What famous prophecy of a coming king appears in Zechariah 9?
options: A great king of Babylon comes at last to subdue all of the many gathered nations
Your king comes, righteous and having salvation, humble and mounted on a donkey
A righteous judge comes to weigh out the deeds of all of the many peoples
A mighty warrior comes, riding upon a swift horse, to go out and make war
questions.answer: Your king comes, righteous and having salvation, humble and mounted on a donkey
